gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-noto-sans-new-ta: Noto Sans New Tai Lue has round, cupped letters, a soft foil to the stencil-cut weight of Balsamiq Sans. The heading face earns its keep when it is big and brief.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-noto-sans-old-so: Approachable curves in Noto Sans Old South Arabian stop short of turning inward, which keeps the body friendly and clean. And Balsamiq Sans draws a bold, uniform line over it, swelling nowhere.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-palanquin: A constant weight runs through every curve of Balsamiq Sans, never pinching, while Palanquin keeps its letters wide-mouthed. Shrink the heading too small and much of that boldness fades.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-reddit-sans: Reddit Sans keeps its e open at the terminal and its strokes uniform in every direction. But Balsamiq Sans supplies the expressive, stencil-cut punch, and that gap in personality is the strength here.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-rosario: Contemporary and approachable, Rosario lets the ends of its c stay open, a gentle partner for Balsamiq Sans. The heading's unvarying, thin-free stroke is the standout quality here.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-sarala: A constant, pinch-free weight defines Balsamiq Sans, while Sarala draws its strokes like neon glass tubing. Paragraphs in Sarala should read approachably, its distinct gaps keeping each word clear.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-spinnaker: Contemporary letters meet a bold, stencil-cut heading. Spinnaker keeps its counters open to outside space, while Balsamiq Sans holds one weight around every curve; that split is the draw.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-tirra: Loud, expressive lines: Balsamiq Sans holds a constant weight with no pinched curves. Tirra counters with round forms like open parentheses, a sans-serif whose softness is the whole appeal.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-titillium-web: A stroke weight that never varies gives Balsamiq Sans its blunt, bold, expressive look. Titillium Web, with its stroke ends set far apart, reads smoothly and approachably line after line.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-wix-madefor-text: One-tip simplicity in every glyph: that is Balsamiq Sans, bold and drawn with a constant weight. And Wix Madefor Text, with its open terminals, should keep paragraphs feeling contemporary and smooth.
